speaker_title: Address by Mr. Mark Rutte, Prime Minister and Minister for General Affairs of the Kingdom of the Netherlands

paragraphs.text: Mr President, Secretary-General, Your Excellencies, ladies and gentlemen, [PM]
paragraphs.raw_text: Mr President, Secretary-General, Your Excellencies, ladies and gentlemen, [PM]

paragraphs.text: For me, the General Assembly in New York is the ultimate UN experience.
paragraphs.raw_text: For me, the General Assembly in New York is the ultimate UN experience.

paragraphs.text: All the delegations gathered in that imposing hall during the General Debate.
paragraphs.raw_text: All the delegations gathered in that imposing hall during the General Debate.

paragraphs.text: The whole world coming together.
paragraphs.raw_text: The whole world coming together.

paragraphs.text: There’s nothing like it.
paragraphs.raw_text: There’s nothing like it.

paragraphs.text: But this year, everything is different.
paragraphs.raw_text: But this year, everything is different.

paragraphs.text: For the first time in history we’re having a virtual Assembly.
paragraphs.raw_text: For the first time in history we’re having a virtual Assembly.

paragraphs.text: It feels a bit surreal, and it’s far from ideal, but it’s important — despite the restrictions — that we share our views on the international situation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It feels a bit surreal, and it’s far from ideal, but it’s important — despite the 
restrictions — that we share our views on the international situation.

paragraphs.text: Especially this year.
paragraphs.raw_text: Especially this year.

paragraphs.text: Because this is the year of coronavirus.
paragraphs.raw_text: Because this is the year of coronavirus.

paragraphs.text: The impact on our health, our economies and our societies has been enormous.
paragraphs.raw_text: The impact on our health, our economies and our societies has been enormous.

paragraphs.text: Almost every country in the world, including the European and Caribbean parts of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, has been hit hard.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Almost every country in the world, including the European and Caribbean 
parts of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, has been hit hard.

paragraphs.text: The poorest countries hardest of all.
paragraphs.raw_text: The poorest countries hardest of all.

paragraphs.text: Existing problems have been magnified by the pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text: Existing problems have been magnified by the pandemic.

paragraphs.text: And this has forced us to face facts: in times of crisis we have to work together.
paragraphs.raw_text: And this has forced us to face facts: in times of crisis we have to work together.

paragraphs.text: Look out for each other.
paragraphs.raw_text: Look out for each other.

paragraphs.text: Support one another.
paragraphs.raw_text: Support one another.

paragraphs.text: Not only our families, neighbours and compatriots, but also other countries and peoples, regardless of the borders between us.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Not only our families, neighbours and compatriots, but also other countries 
and peoples, regardless of the borders between us.

paragraphs.text: Because we’re all in this together.
paragraphs.raw_text: Because we’re all in this together.

paragraphs.text: The UN is setting the right example.
paragraphs.raw_text: The UN is setting the right example.

paragraphs.text: Not least by setting up the UN COVID-19 Response and Recovery Fund, initiated by Secretary-General Guterres.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Not least by setting up the UN COVID-19 Response and Recovery Fund, 
initiated by Secretary-General Guterres.

paragraphs.text: The Netherlands fully supports the Fund, and so far we’re its biggest donor.
paragraphs.raw_text: The Netherlands fully supports the Fund, and so far we’re its biggest donor.

paragraphs.text: The World Bank and the IMF are also helping the countries most affected.
paragraphs.raw_text: The World Bank and the IMF are also helping the countries most affected.

paragraphs.text: These are fine examples of international solidarity that bode well for the future.
paragraphs.raw_text: These are fine examples of international solidarity that bode well for the future.

paragraphs.text: But if we’re truly going to defeat this virus we’ll have to do even more to enhance international cooperation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
But if we’re truly going to defeat this virus we’ll have to do even more to 
enhance international cooperation.

paragraphs.text: It starts with supporting the World Health Organization, which plays a crucial role.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It starts with supporting the World Health Organization, which plays a 

crucial role.

paragraphs.text: We must provide the resources it needs.
paragraphs.raw_text: We must provide the resources it needs.

paragraphs.text: It also means countries need to give the Organization full cooperation and show transparency.
paragraphs.raw_text:
It also means countries need to give the Organization full cooperation and 
show transparency.

paragraphs.text: In some cases this has been lacking.
paragraphs.raw_text: In some cases this has been lacking.

paragraphs.text: At the same time, the WHO has also attracted criticism.
paragraphs.raw_text: At the same time, the WHO has also attracted criticism.

paragraphs.text: The Netherlands agrees that — once the crisis is under control — we should evaluate the situation and look at how we can enhance its powers.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Netherlands agrees that — once the crisis is under control — we should 
evaluate the situation and look at how we can enhance its powers.

paragraphs.text: So that we’re well-equipped to deal with — or better still prevent — any future pandemic.
paragraphs.raw_text:
So that we’re well-equipped to deal with — or better still prevent — any future 
pandemic.

paragraphs.text: Critical evaluation and continuous efforts to improve are key elements of multilateral cooperation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Critical evaluation and continuous efforts to improve are key elements of 
multilateral cooperation.

paragraphs.text: But unfortunately, as we mark the UN’s 75th anniversary, we’re also seeing another trend.
paragraphs.raw_text:
But unfortunately, as we mark the UN’s 75th anniversary, we’re also seeing 
another trend.

paragraphs.text: The multilateral world order, which has given us so much in the decades since World War Two, is under great pressure.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The multilateral world order, which has given us so much in the decades since 
World War Two, is under great pressure.

paragraphs.text: And we need to turn this tide.
paragraphs.raw_text: And we need to turn this tide.

paragraphs.text: Step one is for all countries to take responsibility for the proper functioning of the multilateral system.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Step one is for all countries to take responsibility for the proper functioning of 
the multilateral system.

paragraphs.text: Take a constructive approach.
paragraphs.raw_text: Take a constructive approach.

paragraphs.text: Stand up for your own interests, but don’t lose sight of the common interest.
paragraphs.raw_text: Stand up for your own interests, but don’t lose sight of the common interest.

paragraphs.text: And last but not least, honour the agreements we’ve made and respect international law, including human rights. When it comes to multilateralism, you can’t pick and choose.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And last but not least, honour the agreements we’ve made and respect 
international law, including human rights. When it comes to multilateralism, you 
can’t pick and choose.

paragraphs.text: Step two is to critically assess the system itself.
paragraphs.raw_text: Step two is to critically assess the system itself.

paragraphs.text: Because there’s work to be done there too.
paragraphs.raw_text: Because there’s work to be done there too.

paragraphs.text: We can’t tackle today’s challenges with yesterday’s structures.
paragraphs.raw_text: We can’t tackle today’s challenges with yesterday’s structures.

paragraphs.text: It’s essential that we improve, reform and modernise our global institutions.
paragraphs.raw_text: It’s essential that we improve, reform and modernise our global institutions.

paragraphs.text: And the UN is no exception.
paragraphs.raw_text: And the UN is no exception.

paragraphs.text: During our recent membership of the UN Security Council, the Netherlands worked hard on practical UN reforms in the area of peacekeeping.
paragraphs.raw_text:
During our recent membership of the UN Security Council, the Netherlands 
worked hard on practical UN reforms in the area of peacekeeping.

paragraphs.text: And we fully support the broad reform agenda of SecretaryGeneral Guterres.
paragraphs.raw_text: And we fully support the broad reform agenda of SecretaryGeneral Guterres.

paragraphs.text: Together we need to ensure that the UN — now 75 years old — remains fit for purpose, well-equipped and young at heart.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Together we need to ensure that the UN — now 75 years old — remains fit for 
purpose, well-equipped and young at heart.

paragraphs.text: That it’s ready for the next 75 years.
paragraphs.raw_text: That it’s ready for the next 75 years.

paragraphs.text: Because the new generations, who are already making their voices heard, must be able to count on a solid global system of multilateral cooperation.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Because the new generations, who are already making their voices heard, must 
be able to count on a solid global system of multilateral cooperation.

paragraphs.text: The Kingdom of the Netherlands will keep working towards that end, in every way possible.
paragraphs.raw_text:
The Kingdom of the Netherlands will keep working towards that end, in every 
way possible.

paragraphs.text: By providing financial resources, for example: we are one of the ten biggest donors to the multilateral system and we try to play a constructive role.
paragraphs.raw_text:
By providing financial resources, for example: we are one of the ten biggest 
donors to the multilateral system and we try to play a constructive role.

paragraphs.text: But also by sharing our expertise in areas like climate adaptation.
paragraphs.raw_text: But also by sharing our expertise in areas like climate adaptation.

paragraphs.text: A topic that’s in the very DNA of our Kingdom, which is made up of a lowlying delta by the North Sea and several small islands in the Caribbean.
paragraphs.raw_text:
A topic that’s in the very DNA of our Kingdom, which is made up of a low-
lying delta by the North Sea and several small islands in the Caribbean.

paragraphs.text: In January 2021, we will be hosting the Climate Adaptation Summit to help the world prepare better for the effects of climate change.
paragraphs.raw_text:
In January 2021, we will be hosting the Climate Adaptation Summit to help the 
world prepare better for the effects of climate change.

paragraphs.text: Another contribution we make is providing a base for the international legal order.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Another contribution we make is providing a base for the international 

legal order.

paragraphs.text: My home town of The Hague is host to the International Court of Justice and the International Criminal Court, for example.
paragraphs.raw_text:
My home town of The Hague is host to the International Court of Justice and 
the International Criminal Court, for example.

paragraphs.text: We must continue supporting these crucial institutions.
paragraphs.raw_text: We must continue supporting these crucial institutions.

paragraphs.text: Even though it’s become harder and harder in recent years to achieve accountability, due mainly to resistance from a small number of countries.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Even though it’s become harder and harder in recent years to achieve 
accountability, due mainly to resistance from a small number of countries.

paragraphs.text: But we won’t let that stop us.
paragraphs.raw_text: But we won’t let that stop us.

paragraphs.text: We will find other ways.
paragraphs.raw_text: We will find other ways.

paragraphs.text: Like the international mechanism for collecting and analysing evidence of the most serious crimes committed in Syria.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Like the international mechanism for collecting and analysing evidence of the 
most serious crimes committed in Syria.

paragraphs.text: Or the step the Netherlands recently took, holding Syria formally responsible for human rights violations.
paragraphs.raw_text:
Or the step the Netherlands recently took, holding Syria formally responsible 
for human rights violations.

paragraphs.text: And for our country in particular, the establishment of special court proceedings to try those accused of downing flight MH17 was a major milestone.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And for our country in particular, the establishment of special court proceedings 
to try those accused of downing flight MH17 was a major milestone.

paragraphs.text: Because justice must be served.
paragraphs.raw_text: Because justice must be served.

paragraphs.text: And because justice is a central pillar of our multilateral world order.
paragraphs.raw_text: And because justice is a central pillar of our multilateral world order.

paragraphs.text: We work in all these areas, in the full conviction that international cooperation brings us progress.
paragraphs.raw_text:
We work in all these areas, in the full conviction that international cooperation 
brings us progress.

paragraphs.text: And although the current crisis forces us to keep our distance, now more than ever we need to come closer together.
paragraphs.raw_text:
And although the current crisis forces us to keep our distance, now more than 
ever we need to come closer together.

paragraphs.text: Thank you.
paragraphs.raw_text: Thank you.
